label: Frontiers in Immunology
description: Frontiers in Immunology (Frontiers). A Frontiers journal: the Article types page carries the per-type maximum word counts (Original Research 12,000; Review 12,000; Mini Review 3,000; Brief Research Report 4,000; Case Report 3,000; Opinion 2,000; General Commentary 1,000; …) and the figure/table caps. Frontiers counts the manuscript length over the main body only (footnotes and in-text citations included; abstract, section titles, captions, table/box contents, funding, acknowledgments and references excluded), publishes no separate abstract word limit (one structured paragraph, no citations), and asks for a 200-word scope statement in the submission system. The profile applies the venue's own maximum with no margin (relaxation 1.0).
